meta.title: Turnbasedgame — Text, Dialogue and Lore Data
meta.scope: Narrative and player-facing text only. No stats, HP, MP costs, power, chances, temperament or sprite sizes.

status_tags.decided: Decided by Kiki in the GDD
status_tags.proposal: Claude's suggestion in the GDD, still for review
status_tags.placeholder: Prototype placeholder text, free to rewrite

meta.expression_tag_usage: A line can start with a tag like [happy] to pick the portrait face. No tag means neutral.
meta.article_rule: Critter names carry the article 'the ' ("Bo bonks the Big Frog!"). The first letter of every sentence is capitalized automatically.

world.pitch: A story-driven, wacky RPG in 2D pixel art, in the spirit of EarthBound and the early Pokémon games. Bo, a horned girl, sets out with Ale to rescue Kevin, her father figure, who was kidnapped by angels for the gods' yearly tournament on the Great White Peak. Cat-shaped guardians help them along the way, and the runaway prince Willhelm and the outpost builder Len join the party.
tone: Wacky, nonsensical and boldly fun, in the spirit of EarthBound: everyday places with strange things happening in them.
The rescue plot gives it a heartfelt core, and the Kevin twist gives it a darker turn at the end.
New characters and critters added later should be weirder and wackier still.
world.heart_of_the_story: Bo tries to save someone she believes is a good person, and comes to realize that she is one of the lost souls herself, until, by some miracle, she becomes conscious.
world.how_lore_reaches_the_player: Most lore sits in libraries and artefacts found around the world. Reading it is optional: the player never has to read or understand it to follow the game.
lore_at_a_glance: The Godmother created the gods. Gods look like normal humans with magic and a near-immortality, and rule kingdoms from their palaces like kings and queens with praying followers.
Religions: the Ancient, the Familia (Twin Gods), the Bordella (Six Gods), the Blue Eyes (the Blue Souls) and Mother Nature (the Godmother). Some critters are devout followers.

The gods come every year to the Lotus Stadium on top of the Great White Peak to watch a tournament that searches for the greatest warriors of all worlds. The Six Gods come mostly for entertainment; the Twin Gods stay away.
Angels (winged creatures sent by a god) serve that tournament. They are the ones who kidnap Kevin.
The Terrible Brothers (Karfagath, Gorlomuth, Seelufath, Zomrudath) are the villains. Their followers are ordered to kill Bo.
Guardians are cat-shaped beings who look after travelers, places and paths. Each guardian is a named side character with a backstory and a personality.
Sentinels are dog-shaped beings from a far-away land, locked in a long-running conflict with the Guardians. One Sentinel, the husky merchant Meelo, travels in this land.

Guardians and Sentinels are sacred creatures, older than the Godmother herself. Free spirits who roam the regions and help the innocent or anyone in need. Over time each grew a distinct personality: they still act as saviours, but don't expect too much from them.
At the tournament, nearly every guardian of the region gathers at the stadium as viewers and referees, making sure the tournament follows the ancient rule.
Critters are the wild creatures of the world, and the ones the party can recruit.
Wanderers are lost souls who fell into this reality from other worlds. This explains the strange people the party meets (the Machinist is one). Bo is secretly one of the lost souls.
Hofflers are a small tribe of knowledge keepers who live mostly in the Tower of Knowledge and in libraries around the world. Ale is a Hoffler.
The world mixes the everyday with the strange.

religions.name: The Ancient
religions.description: The oldest religion. Their god never appears and never does anything magical in this world.

religions.name: The Blue Eyes
religions.worships: The Blue Souls, the King of the Souls
religions.description: The King of the Souls built the barrier of the Gray Forest.

religions.name: Mother Nature
religions.worships: The Godmother, the mother of the gods

general: The Godmother created the gods. Nobody knows how, or where her power comes from.
A god looks like a normal human, with magic and a near-immortality. Gods live for hundreds of years and build their own kingdoms, with followers who pray to them.
Each god lives in their own palace, in regions outside the map of this game.
Other gods exist in the world, but they make no appearance.

godmother.name: The Godmother
godmother.role: Creator of the gods; the true power behind the story.
godmother.power: God-like. Its source is unknown. She influences the creatures of the world.
godmother.rule: She sets rules for her gods. Karfagath's forbidden ritual breaks one, and she punishes him for it.
godmother.in_the_story: Bo confronts her at the Lotus Stadium to bring Kevin back. She controls Kevin's monstrous husk as the final boss, and flees the stadium to another region once Bo is winning.
godmother.sequel: Bo goes after her to kill her.

six_gods.title: The Six Gods (the gods of nature)
six_gods.description: Their palace is in another region. They come to the stadium at first just for entertainment. When Bo arrives, all six are keen to fight her fairly in the stadium, one by one, and they are killed in the action.

twin_gods.title: The Twin Gods
twin_gods.description: Absent from the stadium. Their palace is in another region. Worshipped by the Familia. Bo faces them in the sequel.

terrible_brothers.description: Four brothers, each the symbol of two vices. After the ritual, the remaining brothers and their followers are ordered to kill Bo, and she fights them along the journey.

members.name: Karfagath
members.role: The one Bo knows as Kevin. His monstrous husk, controlled by the Godmother, is the final boss.

members.name: Gorlomuth
members.role: His followers are about to sacrifice Willhelm to him. Bo rescues Willhelm and defeats Gorlomuth.

members.name: Zomrudath
members.role: Fakes his death. After the Godmother flees the stadium, he shows up and tells Bo the truth about Kevin and the ritual.

villains.angels: Winged creatures sent by a god to serve the tournament. They kidnap Kevin.

regions.name: Meadree Plain
regions.where: Surrounds the Great White Peak; sits in the middle of the map and links the other regions.
regions.description: A green plain made mostly of hills. The Tall Sanctuary stands in one corner of it, and outposts dot the roads.
regions.inhabitants: Ferrals and the everyday mix of critters.

regions.name: The Gray Forest
regions.where: West of Meadree Plain, hidden behind the hills.
regions.description: Covered by an everlasting mist and filled with lost and broken souls. Its barrier was built by the King of the Souls (worshipped by the Blue Eyes). A cave links it to Bo's old home.

regions.name: The Crags
regions.where: Between Meadree Plain and the Great White Peak.
regions.description: Rocky slopes that connect the plain to the mountain.

regions.name: Great White Peak
regions.where: The snowy mountain at the center of the plain.
regions.description: Home of the Lotus Stadium, where the gods watch the yearly tournament. Neo's resort sits at the peak.
regions.inhabitants: Tournament challengers and snow critters. Gus guards the stadium; Meelo trades at the resort.

regions.name: Hidden Burrows
regions.where: Under the world (exact entrance to be decided).
regions.description: A forbidden place. People who enter it want to do something their gods forbid, and the Burrows is the one place where they can do it unseen.
regions.inhabitants: Idols, Electronics (proposal) and other strange critters.

places.name: Tall Sanctuary
places.description: The party's home base and a safe space for any traveler. It is actually a library: once a research facility, abandoned after its research turned up little of use. Ale lives and studies here, and Niko runs recovery, critter merging and upgrades here. Oky brought Len here after rescuing him.

places.name: Outposts
places.description: Fast-travel checkpoints along the regions, built by Len to repay the guardians' kindness. Reen and Dewey wait inside a hut next to each outpost.

places.name: Neo's resort
places.description: A ski resort at the top of the Great White Peak. Neo's ski route links the peak and the plain. Meelo runs his critter trading stall here.

places.name: Lotus Stadium
places.description: The tournament venue and the end goal. Gus sets the trials the player must clear before entering. The guardians watch and referee here.

places.name: Tower of Knowledge
places.description: Home of the Hofflers, the keepers of knowledge.

places.name: The cave
places.description: Between Bo's home and the Gray Forest. Where the story begins: Bo walks against the wind, finds this cave and comes out lost in the forest.

places.name: Graveyards
places.description: Along with the Gray Forest, the main home of Souls.

places.name: Vending machines
places.description: Where the player pays coins to save. They stand at outposts, the Tall Sanctuary, Neo's resort and the Lotus Stadium.
places.sample_line: The machine hums. It accepts your coins. It looks satisfied.

prologue.title: Kevin is taken
prologue.text: Kevin raised Bo for as long as she can remember. Winged creatures kidnap him. His last words to her: pack your things and walk against the direction the wind blows.

prologue.title: Lost in the Gray Forest
prologue.text: Bo follows his words, finds a cave and comes out in the Gray Forest, completely lost. Still trying to process what happened, she breaks down crying.

prologue.title: Oky
prologue.text: The black cat guardian Oky appears, calms her down and leads her out of the forest to the Tall Sanctuary.

prologue.title: The Tall Sanctuary
prologue.text: Bo meets Ale, a young Hoffler girl who has just arrived there and studies the books and the creatures with the guardians' help. At first sight Bo thinks Ale is Kevin's younger sister (Kevin looked like a Hoffler). The two get along well.

prologue.title: The goal
prologue.text: From Ale's knowledge, the creatures that took Kevin are angels sent by a god, and they hold a tournament at the stadium on top of the snowy mountain. Bo resolves to get stronger and gather allies to rescue Kevin.

journey: The party starts as Bo and Ale.
The first boss is the Big Frog. After the boss fight it appears as a normal wild critter in the world.
Willhelm joins: Bo rescues him from a wild creature just as he is about to be sacrificed to Gorlomuth. Bo defeats Gorlomuth, hears Willhelm's story and decides to help him.
Len joins: he has been building outposts since Oky rescued him; he knows about the tournament and joins Bo's party just to watch it.
Along the way they meet more characters and recruit critters to grow the party.
The remaining Terrible Brothers and their followers, ordered to kill Bo, attack along the journey. Zomrudath seemingly dies.
The path leads through the rocky slopes and up the Great White Peak: clear Gus's trials, then enter the tournament at the Lotus Stadium.

endgame.text: Bo confronts the Godmother to bring Kevin back.
The Six Gods fight Bo fairly, one by one, and fall.
Final boss: Kevin's monstrous husk, controlled by the Godmother.
Seeing Bo win, the Godmother flees to another region.
Zomrudath reveals he faked his death and tells Bo the truth: Kevin is Karfagath, and Bo is the vengeful soul his forbidden ritual brought to him.
Ending: Bo decides to go after the Godmother and kill her.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: Envy
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: Karfagath always felt he was the worst one, the unfavored one, among the people and in the Godmother's eyes. He was always looked down on, and he hated it.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: The forbidden ritual
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: He tries a forbidden ritual that sacrifices his power, hoping to find someone he can love and who will love him back.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: Bo
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: Bo is the result of the ritual: she is one of the vengeful souls, the soul of a schoolgirl who died in a train accident.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: Kevin
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: With the very last of his power, Karfagath transforms himself to look like a Hoffler, the same race as Ale. He raises Bo as Kevin.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: Ale
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: This is why, the first time Bo sees Ale, she thinks Ale is Kevin's younger sister.

twist_truth_about_kevin.title: The punishment
twist_truth_about_kevin.text: The ritual broke the Godmother's rule. Karfagath is punished, and only his real monstrous husk of a body remains.

sequel: Bo fights the angry followers of the gods (after the Six Gods fall).
She confronts the Godmother once again.

story_races.name: Raiders
story_races.description: The playable characters, with many unique interactions and events. Every story character who joins the party is a Raider. Raiders and Guardians are the only races that talk on their own in battle.

story_races.name: Guardians
story_races.description: Sacred, free-spirited creatures, older than the Godmother. Important named side characters, each with a backstory and a personality. Met through the story and services, never in the wild. At the tournament they gather as viewers and referees.

story_races.name: Sentinels
story_races.description: Sacred creatures like the Guardians, also older than the Godmother. Mostly live in a far-away land. Locked in a long-running conflict with the Guardians.

story_races.name: Hofflers
story_races.description: A small tribe of keepers of knowledge, living in the Tower of Knowledge and libraries around the world. Kevin took a Hoffler's look as his disguise.

story_races.name: Gods
story_races.description: Magic and a near-immortality; created by the Godmother. Fought as bosses.

critter_races.name: Ferrals
critter_races.description: Able to talk, and unfriendly. Rude talkers.

critter_races.name: Kits
critter_races.description: Unpredictable. Give extra rewards when defeated, and can be consumed after being recruited.

critter_races.name: Wanderers
critter_races.look: Like normal humans, but slightly off
critter_races.description: Lost souls who fell into this reality from other worlds.

critter_races.name: Souls
critter_races.description: Speak their own language. The player must unlock the Souls language before talking to them.

critter_races.name: Monuments
critter_races.description: Sturdy, built things that somehow move and fight. How are these things even here?

critter_races.name: Electronics
critter_races.description: Speak their own language. The player must unlock the Electronics language before talking to them.

critter_races.name: Idols
critter_races.description: Very hard to recruit. A successful recruit can bring a curse.

critter_races.name: Sprouts
critter_races.description: Walking plants, cheerful and nosy.

critter_races.name: Snacks
critter_races.description: Runaway food, scared of being eaten.

critter_races.name: Mascots
critter_races.description: People stuck in costumes, way too upbeat.

critter_races.name: Shrooms
critter_races.description: Mushroom folk, sleepy and gossipy.

critter_races.name: Mists
critter_races.description: Fog that took a shape, shy.

critter_races.name: Bugs
critter_races.description: Tiny insects with huge egos.

critter_races.name: Rollers
critter_races.description: Boulder creatures that only roll downhill.

critter_races.name: Diggers
critter_races.description: Miners, moles and treasure hunters.

critter_races.name: Birds
critter_races.description: Proud mountain birds who want to be angels.

critter_races.name: Frosties
critter_races.description: Snow and ice creatures, grumpy when warm.

critter_races.name: Athletes
critter_races.description: Tournament hopefuls who failed the trials.

critter_races.name: Toys
critter_races.description: Lost toys looking for an owner.

critter_races.name: Grubs
critter_races.description: Burrow larvae, always hungry.

critter_races.name: Shadows
critter_races.description: Shadows that left their owners.

critter_races.name: Fallen
critter_races.description: Low-rank angels who quit the job.

critter_races.name: Followers
critter_races.description: Devout cultists of the Terrible Brothers.

raiders.name: Bo
raiders.look: A young girl with messy short black hair, pale skin and red eyes, with a pair of white horns at the front of her head.
raiders.personality: Deadpan. She looks tired and uninterested all the time. Underneath, she is fiercely determined to bring Kevin back.
raiders.backstory: Raised by Kevin since her earliest memory. When angels kidnap him, she follows his last words, walks against the wind, and ends up lost in the Gray Forest, where Oky finds her crying and leads her to the Tall Sanctuary. 'Bo' is the name she goes by; her real name is a mystery.
raiders.secret: She is the vengeful soul of a schoolgirl who died in a train accident, brought by Karfagath's forbidden ritual. By some miracle, she becomes conscious.
raiders.goal: Get stronger, gather allies and rescue Kevin from the tournament at the Lotus Stadium. After the ending: kill the Godmother.
raiders.role: Debuff the enemy, then attack quickly.

upgrades.name: Twin Blades Crit
upgrades.description: Increase the critical chance of the basic attack

upgrades.name: Thumbs Down+
upgrades.description: Thumbs Down now also decreases Accuracy

skills.name: Double Slash
skills.description: A spin attack with the twin blades that hits 2 times.

skills.name: Thumbs Down
skills.battle_text: {user} points at {target} and gives thumbs down.

skills.name: Sit Down
skills.description: She sits down and just stares at the enemies, with a chance to taunt one or more of them.

battle_start_player: [happy] Aww, too bad you can't hide
battle_start_enemy: Can you just leave me alone, please?
turn_start: [bored] I'm starting to not like this
[bored] Ugh... I know, I know... fight that thing
recruit_fail: Oh, you will regret that, buddy

raiders.name: Ale
raiders.look: A young girl with short blonde hair and side bangs. A long tuft of front hair resembles an owl's. Green eyes and glasses.
raiders.personality: Energetic and clumsy. She loves collecting information and fills her notes with it, eager to earn as much credit as possible.
raiders.backstory: A Hoffler, from the tribe of knowledge keepers. Newly arrived at the Tall Sanctuary, where she studies the books and the creatures with the guardians' help. Her knowledge identifies Kevin's kidnappers as angels sent by a god. When Bo first sees her, Bo thinks she is Kevin's younger sister.
raiders.role: Buffs the entire team and handles recovery; can also be played aggressively to deal massive damage.
raiders.story_hook: Her notes can double as the in-game critter bestiary.

upgrades.name: Overheal
upgrades.description: Enable the Overheal passive: healing beyond max HP turns into a temporary shield

upgrades.name: Cheer +
upgrades.description: Unlock the Cheer skill, which increases the Attack of all allies

upgrades.name: Electro +
upgrades.description: Add a Paralyze chance to Electro Incantation, which can stop enemies from moving

upgrades.name: Frost +
upgrades.description: Make Frost Incantation's stun last longer

skills.name: Book Throw
skills.description: Deals light physical damage. The book can't be used afterward.

skills.name: Fire Incantation
skills.description: Deals fire damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Electro Incantation
skills.description: Deals electric damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Frost Incantation
skills.description: Deals ice damage to a single enemy and stuns it for 1 turn.

boss_start: I had a bad feeling about this
miss: [angry] This is starting to piss me off
[sad] Calm down, Al, it's not over.
humiliate: Aww, it's okay, you can try again
It's quite reasonable to give up now, by the way
ally_critter_low_hp: Don't worry, guys, I can heal
ally_critter_downed: [angry] I will do something like that to you, but even worse
enemy_defeated: I hope you dropped something valuable
[happy] I'll tell your friends about it
recruit_success: [happy] Everyone, listen! I'm pleased to announce a new member of the team
recruit_fail: This is not like anything I read about recruitment

recruiting_quirk.text: Asks critters for their bestiary notes first, and flusters them.

raiders.name: Willhelm
raiders.look: Dark red hair; very young and skinny. After his betrayals on the road, he looks more like a beggar than a prince.
raiders.personality: Young and naive at first. Grows more grounded later in the story.
raiders.backstory: A prince from a far-away kingdom in trouble. He travels to the yearly tournament hoping to win it, bring its wealth home, gain other kingdoms' support and make his father proud. Knowing his chances are small, he makes friends along the way, and is betrayed several times.
raiders.how_he_joins: Bo rescues him from a wild creature as he is about to be sacrificed to Gorlomuth. After defeating Gorlomuth, Bo hears his story and decides to help him. They learn to fight and gather allies together.
raiders.role: Magic damage and debuffing the enemy, hitting groups.
raiders.weakness: Very weak against Taunt and Charmed.

recruiting_quirk.text: Critters mock or pity the broke prince when he uses Ask for Money.

raiders.name: Len
raiders.look: White hair and brown skin, tanned from his work outdoors.
raiders.personality: Self-doubting, but grows along the journey. Enjoys being alone, gets bored of it and tries to get along with everyone. Terrible at talking, great strength.
raiders.voice: Talks badly: his battle lines can be awkward, cut short or misfire, which grows less over the journey as he opens up.
raiders.backstory: A young crew member of a pirate ship destroyed by a sea monster. He woke on the shore, where Oky found him and brought him to the Tall Sanctuary. To repay the guardians, he started building the outposts where travelers can rest.
raiders.how_he_joins: He knows about the tournament and joins Bo's party, just to watch it.
raiders.role: Tank: takes the damage and gives massive physical buffs.

recruiting_quirk.text: His awkward talking makes the recruit questions go strangely, for better or worse.

story_characters.name: Kevin
story_characters.true_identity: Karfagath, one of the Terrible Brothers
story_characters.role: Bo's father figure, the one who raised her.
story_characters.story: Kidnapped by angels at the start of the game. His last words send Bo on her journey.
story_characters.last_words: Pack your things and walk against the direction the wind blows.
story_characters.secret: He is Karfagath, the Terrible Brother of greed and envy, who used his last power to take a Hoffler's form. Punished by the Godmother, only his monstrous husk remains: the final boss.

guardians.name: Oky
guardians.job: Saved Bo in the Gray Forest, and Len on the shore. Joins and leaves the party at random, and hands Bo items along the journey.
guardians.personality: Free spirit who goes wherever and whenever he likes. Sometimes refuses an order and licks himself instead.

recruiting_quirk.text: Some critters join just to be near the cat.

guardians.name: Niko
guardians.job: Recovery, critter merging, weapon and gear upgrades.
guardians.personality: The sanctuary's resident cat and the party's reliable helper.

guardians.name: Kiki
guardians.job: Last-second hero: after enough game overs, he appears whenever a battle hits the game over condition and forces the win. Recruitable after finishing his side quest.
guardians.personality: Quiet and cool: speaks almost entirely in "...". A safety net for players who keep hitting game over.
guardians.battle_line_style: Mostly dots, with a rare short word saved for big moments, like his last-second rescue. Dot length and punctuation carry his mood; the portrait expression does the rest.
guardians.rescue_line_note: The big moment where Kiki says one of his rare real words. Not written yet.

rescue_attack.note: Strong attack that ends a rescued battle fast. Not written yet.

guardians.name: Neo
guardians.where: Resort at the top of the Great White Peak
guardians.job: Fast travel between the peak and the plain via her ski equipment and route.
guardians.personality: Owner of the resort. Very polite, polite enough to host Meelo, a Sentinel, at her resort.

guardians.name: Gus
guardians.job: Sets the trials the player must clear before entering the tournament.
guardians.personality: Guardian of the stadium. A cat of few words: short, blunt words.

guardians.name: Reen
guardians.where: The hut next to each outpost
guardians.personality: Moody: sometimes she heals only one specific character.

guardians.name: Yoon
guardians.job: Traveling merchant of sketchy items, sometimes at a great deal. Sells books that unlock language barriers and talking skills (negotiation, ask for money, ask for donation, ask for item, bluffing, influencing).
guardians.personality: A shady seller with the occasional bargain.

guardians.name: Dewey
guardians.where: The hut next to each outpost
guardians.job: Advanced weapon and gear upgrades beyond Niko's.
guardians.personality: Sometimes hikes his prices, and the player can complain to get a fair one.

sentinels.name: Meelo
sentinels.where: Neo's ski resort, top of the Great White Peak
sentinels.job: Critter trader: buys recruited critters and sells locked critters.
sentinels.personality: A traveler and merchant from the Sentinels' far-away land. Refuses to trade while a Guardian is in the active party.
sentinels.guardian_refusal_note: Proposal: a few unique lines when the player arrives with a Guardian (Meelo and Oky trading glares; Kiki answering with "......").

critters.name: the Big Frog
critters.role: First boss, later a wild critter.
critters.description: A huge frog with a very strong poison attack. As a Ferral, it talks, rudely.
critters.battle_intro: {target} hops out of the pond! The ground shakes!

moves.name: Toxic Spit
moves.battle_text: {user} hocks a glob of toxic spit at {target}!

critters.item_request_example: The Big Frog looks nervous. It asks for a Bug Snack!

critters.name: the Laughing Mannequin
critters.description: A mannequin that won't stop laughing. Gets pumped up when it humiliates its opponent.

moves.name: Slap
moves.battle_text: {user} slaps {target} with a stiff plastic hand!

moves.name: Point and Laugh
moves.battle_text: {user} points at {target} and laughs. And laughs.

traits.name: Laugh Boost
traits.description: Gets pumped up after landing a debuff.
traits.battle_text: {user} laughs so hard it gets pumped up!

critters.unique_interaction_example: Which one of us is the real one?

critters.name: the Flying Stone Thing
critters.description: A floating chunk of stone with a tough shell that cracks once it's worn down.

traits.name: Stone Skin
traits.description: Tough against Physical and Magical damage above 50% HP.
traits.battle_text: {target}'s stony shell cracks! It looks squishy now!

critters.name: the Funny Looking Orb
critters.description: A floating white orb that speaks the Souls language. Nobody knows what it wants.

moves.name: Weird Glow
moves.battle_text: {user} glows in a way that feels illegal.

moves.name: Long Stare
moves.battle_text: {user} stares without blinking. It has no eyelids.

critters.note: Before the Souls language unlock, its lines should show as unreadable glyphs.

critters.name: the Machinist
critters.description: A random dude pulled in from another world. Cheers up the party and cleans away bad vibes. Just wants to go home.

moves.name: Pep Rally
moves.battle_text: {user} cheers everyone on! "Go team! Whoever you are!"

critters.name: Floppy
critters.description: A floppy-disk-shaped critter. Consuming it saves the game on the spot. Common in the wild.

actions.name: Call In
actions.description: Brings a reserve member into an empty slot, or swaps one in.

actions.name: Taunt
actions.description: Gives the target the Taunt status, so it attacks the taunter.

actions.name: Ask for Money
actions.description: The critter may hand over coins, get annoyed, or laugh at the party. In non-boss battles it can end the battle.

actions.name: Give Money
actions.description: Pays coins to a critter. Some critters leave the battle happily.

actions.name: Give Item
actions.description: Hands an item to a critter; some critters want specific items.

talking_skills._about: Yoon sells books that unlock language barriers and talking skills (decided Nov 22). Everything except negotiation works in non-boss battles only.

negotiation._about: The recruit talk (decided Nov 22). The critter picks a random question (at most 3 per talk), the player picks an answer, and the critter's race reacts with a line and an outcome. An outcome either ends the talk or sends it back to another question. Races can share a reaction set. Mood is a stack on the critter that changes its reactions and closes the talk when the critter is too angry. A high Luck can soften a hostile reaction and adds a mood stack. Details in file 18.

outcomes.heal_party: The critter heals all active party members.

questions.text: Would you find me a soulmate?

A.line: What? You're lying, aren't you? I can see through your lies. Prepare to die!

B.line: You are realistic, I respect that. See you around then.

C.line: Huh, you say no? You have some balls, I liked that, fine I will join you.

A.line: Hmmm, this answer does not sit well with me.

B.line: I liked thou honesty, word of advice, stay away from beauty, only look for honesty.

A.line: Ah, you're so kind, but I'm not really longing for one, here as a token of friendship.

B.line: I respect your answer, here is a small deed I can do as a reward for your honesty.

conversations._about: Multi-line exchanges between Raiders (and party Guardians) that play when a battle event happens and the conditions are met. When a conversation fires, it plays instead of the speaker's single battle_lines for that event. Several entries can share the same event and conditions; one of them is picked at random, so add more entries to keep a moment fresh.

_fields.event: A key from battle_dialogue_events (recruit_fail, miss, crit, ally_downed ...).
_fields.conditions.actor: Who caused the event (the one who failed the recruit, missed, landed the crit). null = anyone.
_fields.conditions.target: Who the event happened to, when it matters (the ally who got downed, the critter being recruited). Use a character id, a critter id, or a race like "race:souls". null = anyone.
_fields.conditions.requires_in_active_party: Everyone listed must be in the active party and not downed.
_fields.conditions.excludes_in_active_party: None of these can be in the active party.
_fields.conditions.story_flag: Only plays after a story point (for example "willhelm_joined"). null = always.
_fields.once: true = plays only once per save file.
_fields.lines: Played in order. Each line has a speaker (character id) and text. Text can start with an expression tag like [smug]. Optional "style": "speech" (default) or "thought".

When and how Bo learns she is a lost soul, and what the miracle that makes her conscious is.
Who sent the angels that took Kevin: the Godmother (as his punishment), or one of the gods? What do the gods gain from the tournament?
What the tournament's ancient rule is.
What the Tall Sanctuary's old research was about.
Where the Hidden Burrows' entrance and the Tower of Knowledge are, and when the party goes there.
The name and story of the rocky region between the plain and the peak (placeholder: the Crags).
The roots of the Guardian–Sentinel conflict, why Meelo travels so far from his homeland, and why Neo lets him trade at her resort.
The Twin Gods list has four members (girl, boy, woman, man): two pairs of twins, one god in two ages, or a different word than 'twin'? Their names.
Seelufath's fight: where, and what his followers are like.
How Zomrudath fakes his death, and where the player sees it.
The Blue Souls, the King of the Souls, and how the Gray Forest barrier ties to the Souls race and the Blue Eyes.
Which religions show up in gameplay (lines, recruiting reactions, followers as enemies).
